license_note: The official model card and Google's Gemma 4 license page apply Apache-2.0 to the published gemma-4-31B-it weights, tokenizer, and chat template. The Gemma Terms of Use and Gemma Prohibited Use Policy that govern earlier Gemma generations explicitly refer Gemma 4 to the separate Apache-2.0 license, so no use-restriction addendum applies to this release.

access_boundary: This record represents the google/gemma-4-31B-it instruction-tuned release. The gemma-4-31B pre-trained base model, the E2B, E4B, 12B, and 26B A4B variants, the -it-assistant repositories, quantized or QAT checkpoints, the Gemini API and Vertex AI served copies, and later Gemma releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google publishes ungated Safetensors shards, an index, tokenizer, processor, and chat template files under Apache-2.0, plus a technical report
The official model card documents Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and Docker Model Runner paths, and Google documents Gemini API, Vertex AI Model Garden, GKE, Cloud Run, Ollama, llama.cpp, and MLX paths
tradeoffs: The license is stated in model-card metadata and on a Google page rather than in a repository LICENSE file, and Google's Gemma site still links the older Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy alongside it
No deprecation or update posture is documented for the downloadable release, and the served Gemini API copy follows separate API terms
